guideModal.title: How to Get Your Deezer ARL
guideModal.subtitle: Quick 3-step guide to extract your Deezer authentication token from any browser

chrome.step1Desc: Open www.deezer.com in your browser and sign in to your Deezer account.
chrome.step2Desc: Press F12 (or right-click anywhere and choose Inspect), then switch to the Application tab.
chrome.step3Desc: Expand Cookies > https://www.deezer.com. Find the cookie named arl, double-click its value, and copy it.

firefox.step1Desc: Open www.deezer.com in Firefox and sign in to your Deezer account.
firefox.step2Desc: Press F12 (or right-click and choose Inspect), then click the Storage tab.
firefox.step3Desc: Expand Cookies > https://www.deezer.com. Locate the arl entry and copy its Value column.

safari.step1Desc: Open www.deezer.com in Safari or install the Cookie-Editor extension in your browser.
safari.step2Desc: In Safari: Developer Tools (Option+Cmd+I) > Storage > Cookies; or click the Cookie-Editor toolbar button.
safari.step3Desc: Find the cookie named arl and copy its 192-character value.
